text: Until 2026-10-08, `~/bin/mmseqs` on the 16-core x86_64 box was an aarch64 static build. It ran through `binfmt_misc` and `/usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static`, 5 to 8 times slower than native. Jack replaced it with the x86-64 build of the same version, `8cc5ce3`. Every mmseqs timing taken on this box before then was emulated, including the Sep 28 run on 100k targets in `nail-benchmarks/data/tmp-nail`.
